title: %gt — greater than
purpose: Return true when the first value is strictly greater than the second.
notes: Numeric operands compare numerically; two strings compare lexically.
This is the canonical condition builder for %ifElse, %and, %or, and %assert.

avoid.why: %gt needs two separate operands; a single quoted infix string is just one argument, so the transform fails with a 'requires 2 arguments' error. Write %gt @.amount ##1000.
